messages:
Ellie (Design): Short notes from the model-catalog review: presets are hard to find in the filter drawer, performance badges are visually loud and compete with model names, and pinning feels ephemeral. Thoughts?

Marco (PM): Agree. Saved view adoption is low; surface presets above the filter list as a compact control. Add a tiny "Apply to this compare" checkbox to clarify scope.

Sam (Eng): Backend concern noted. For a persistent pin we can store user pins in a small table and return them on session start. Will make an API: GET/PUT /v1/user/pins. Fallback to localStorage for guests.

Ivy (Frontend): Badge fix: remove heavy shadow, switch to light neutral bg, smaller text, align badges right. Quick CSS: `.perf-badge{ background: rgba(15,23,42,0.05); border-radius:6px; font-size:11px; padding:3px 6px; box-shadow:none; }` Also add focus style for keyboard users.

Keisha (A11y): Accessibility: badges need context for screen readers (not just a number). Use aria-label like `aria-label="98th pct latency: 220ms"`. Presets control should be keyboard operable and announce state.

staging-bot: staging-bot: branch `ux/catalog-presets-badges-pin` deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/catalog/compare

Ellie (Design): Proposal: 1) Move Presets control to top of filter rail, 2) Make badges visually secondary, 3) Persist pin per-user, sync to backend on auth, 4) Add aria labels and visible focus. React with :+1: to approve.

Marco (PM): :+1: Will add analytics events for pin_create/pin_remove and include model_id/version in payload.

Sam (Eng): :+1: We'll implement the API and migration path from localStorage. Edge case: pinned version retired -> soft-delete and surface a notice.

Ivy (Frontend): :+1: I'll open a PR with CSS and keyboard tests.

Keisha (A11y): :+1: Happy to run NVDA/VoiceOver checks after deploy.

Ellie (Design): Thanks. I'll update the Figma and drop links in the Jira.

Marco (PM): I'll create the ticket with acceptance criteria and a staging test plan. ETA: end of next week.
